iut_type: End Product (incorporating End Product Core-Complete module with PCB antenna)
customer_question: Can we create the Compliance Folder ourselves instead of having Allion create it? If so, is the cost reduced? Also, can payment terms be net-30 (invoice → month-end cutoff → next month-end payment)?
question_variants: Is Compliance Folder creation mandatory to purchase from Allion, or can we do it ourselves?
If we create our own Compliance Folder, does the service fee change?
For a new client, can we pay on standard invoice terms (net 30) instead of prepayment?
actual_issue: GUGEN asked whether they could handle Compliance Folder creation in-house (to reduce cost) and whether standard net-30 payment terms were available instead of Allion's prepayment requirement for first-time clients.
plain_english_explanation: Compliance Folder creation is not mandatory as an Allion service — the customer can create it themselves. If they do, the ¥100,000 Compliance Folder fee is simply not charged, and no other fee changes. For payment terms: Allion requires prepayment from new customers with no prior transaction history. Standard invoice-based net-30 terms are not available for first-time clients. Once a transaction history is established, payment terms may be negotiable.
consultant_answer: Yes, the customer can create the Compliance Folder themselves — Allion's ¥100,000 Compliance Folder creation fee is then removed from the invoice, and no other line items change. For payment terms: first-time clients must pay in advance (prepayment). Standard net-30 (invoice → month-end cutoff → next month payment) is not available for new clients with no prior transaction history. The Qualification Fee ($11,040) requires SIG's Invoice to be generated by the registering company's SIG account holder and paid via wire transfer (TTS rate applied at time of formal quotation).
decision_logic: Compliance Folder is a Bluetooth SIG compliance obligation for the Listing Owner, not an Allion-only service. Customers who prefer to create it themselves may do so — they simply don't use Allion's creation service. Prepayment policy applies to all new clients regardless of payment method preference — this is Allion's standard risk management practice.
final_recommendation: When prospective clients ask about reducing costs, always mention that Compliance Folder creation is optional to purchase from Allion. Clearly state prepayment requirements upfront for new clients to avoid surprises during order placement.
risk_if_done_wrong: If Compliance Folder is excluded from the service but the customer does not actually create one, they will be non-compliant with SIG requirements. Accepting net-30 terms from a new client without prior authorization exposes Allion to payment risk.
